fusions.name: Rim Smash
fusions.desc: Slams a ring of packed strands around you, dealing 14 blunt damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Brace and Bash
fusions.desc: Drives a fist of packed strands into a target for 28 blunt damage that ignores armour, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spiked Guard
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Last Brace
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a ward that absorbs 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
